instruction: Browse the FlightAware community and locate the Feature Requests area to check what users have recommended.

metadata.explanation: Task variation asking user to navigate to FlightAware discussions and find the Feature Requests category. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab metric to verify the correct category URL is opened. Similar complexity to original - requires navigating through the forum structure to find a specific category.

llm_judge_reasons: Result getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active tab URL from the accessibility tree without reloading the page

The getter function 'get_active_url_from_accessTree' (chrome.py:710-778) reads the Address and search bar text from accessibility tree and returns it as a string URL, preserving the actual navigation state
Metric function 'is_expected_active_tab' (chrome.py:18-38) correctly handles both string URLs and dict formats, extracting the URL appropriately from either format
The metric uses 'compare_urls' for URL comparison, which should handle URL variations and fragments correctly
Expected URL 'https://discussions.flightaware.com/c/feature-requests/6' is specific and correct for the Feature Requests category
Complete coverage: The evaluator verifies the single requirement in the instruction - that the user navigates to the Feature Requests category page
No state timing issues: The getter reads the current browser state without navigation or page reloads
